if (aqi <= 200) return { label: 'Unhealthy', color: 'text-rose-500', icon: , gradient: 'from-rose-500 via-red-500 to-orange-500', bgClasses: 'bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-900 via-orange-900/80 to-rose-900/80', scalePos: Math.min((aqi / 300) * 100, 100), particleOpacity: 0.6 }; return { label: 'Dangerous / Hazardous', color: 'text-fuchsia-600', icon: , gradient: 'from-fuchsia-600 via-purple-600 to-red-600', bgClasses: 'bg-gradient-to-br from-neutral-950 via-purple-950/90 to-red-950/90', scalePos: Math.min((aqi / 300) * 100, 100), particleOpacity: 0.9 };
